<!DOCTYPE html>
<!--
================================================================================
  REPORT: Delivery Route Planner
  PATH:   SalesOrder/Delivery_Route_Planner.htm
  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Turns the day's Fishbowl shipments into an optimized single-vehicle
  ROUND-TRIP from the warehouse. It reads each shipment's ship-to address,
  geocodes it, asks OpenRouteService (ORS) for the best stop order + the road
  route, draws it on a Leaflet/OSM map, and exports the run as a Google Maps
  deep-link, GPX, KML, CSV manifest, or a printed run-sheet.

  Cloned from Template/Core_Dashboard_Template.htm — reuses the shared fb-lib /
  fb-styles chrome (header, drawers, settings persistence, debug drawer) and the
  Blob-download + new-window print patterns. Domain layer (SQL, ORS, map,
  exports) is this report's own.

  DEFAULTS: "Shipped today" — ship.statusId=30 AND DATE(ship.dateShipped)=today.
            Packed (statusId 20) is a manual option, matched on dateLastModified
            (approximate — Fishbowl has no packed timestamp).

  PREREQUISITE: the Fishbowl client machine needs outbound internet to reach
  api.openrouteservice.org and the basemap tiles. On a locked-down network the
  mapping is unavailable; the report degrades to an unordered stop list + CSV.
  NOTE: tile.openstreetmap.org CANNOT be used — see the TILE_PROVIDERS comment.

  The shared fb-lib is inlined once (inside the inline script near the top of
  head) and fb-styles once (in the style block). Never repeat either directive
  placeholder anywhere else in this file — Fishbowl expands every occurrence.
================================================================================
-->
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Delivery Route Planner — Fishbowl BI</title>

    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/moment.js/2.29.4/moment.min.js"></script>

    <!-- Leaflet (map). CDN — consistent with the ORS internet requirement.
         Can be inlined for fully locked-down networks. -->
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css" />
    <script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"></script>

    <!-- Shared Fishbowl BI lib — inlined by Fishbowl from the saved "fb-lib"
         script. Source of truth: scripts/fb-lib.js. -->
    <script>
        {% Script fb-lib %}
    </script>

    <!-- Shared Fishbowl BI stylesheet — inlined from the saved "fb-styles"
         Style. Source of truth: scripts/fb-styles.css. Must come BEFORE the
         inline block so per-report rules win the cascade. -->
    <style>
        {% Style fb-styles %}
    </style>

    <style>
        * { box-sizing: border-box; }
        html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; height: 100%; }
        body {
            font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
            font-size: 13px; color: #1e293b; background: #f8fafc;
            display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 100vh;
            padding-bottom: var(--debug-drawer-h, 0px);
            transition: padding-bottom 0.12s ease;
        }
        /* Keep the header (and its dropdowns) above the Leaflet map, which
           otherwise paints over the top-bar selectors in the embedded browser. */
        header { position: relative; z-index: 1100; }
        header h1 { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a; margin: 0; line-height: 1.15; }
        #statusLine { font-size: 12px; color: #94a3b8; line-height: 1.15; margin: 2px 0 0; }
        .hdr-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }

        /* Drawer grid + fields (from the template). */
        .fb-grid { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px 22px; align-items: flex-start; }
        .fb-group { flex: 1 1 220px; min-width: 220px; }
        .fb-group-title { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #475569; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding-bottom: 4px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
        .fb-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
        .fb-field label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: #475569; }
        .fb-field select, .fb-field input[type=text], .fb-field input[type=date], .fb-field input[type=password], .fb-field input[type=number] {
            padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 12px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 6px; background: #f9fafb; font-family: inherit; color: #374151;
        }
        .fb-field input[type=date] { background: #fff; }
        .fb-help { font-size: 10.5px; color: #94a3b8; line-height: 1.35; }

        /* Settings drawer only: pack the groups into ≥4 narrow columns so the
           dropdowns/inputs don't stretch to half the drawer width. (Scoped to
           #setOverlay so the Help drawer's wider flex groups are untouched.) */
        #setOverlay .fb-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 14px 22px; align-items: start; }
        #setOverlay .fb-group { flex: none; min-width: 0; }
        #setOverlay .fb-field select, #setOverlay .fb-field input[type=text], #setOverlay .fb-field input[type=number] { width: 100%; }
        /* Truck restrictions carry five numeric fields — give the group two grid
           columns so they sit on one row instead of stacking down a narrow one. */
        #setOverlay #hgvGroup { grid-column: span 2; }
        @media (max-width: 900px) { #setOverlay .fb-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); } }
        /* Single-column: span 2 would spawn an implicit second column, so reset it. */
        @media (max-width: 520px) { #setOverlay .fb-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } #setOverlay #hgvGroup { grid-column: auto; } }

        /* The backdrop scrim behind an open Settings/Help drawer is injected +
           managed by fb-lib (registerDrawer → #fbDrawerScrim). Do NOT add a
           local scrim, and do NOT override `.fb-drawer.open { z-index }`:
           fb-styles layers the drawer at z-index 10001 and fb-lib's scrim at
           10000, so the drawer sits ABOVE the scrim. Lowering the drawer's
           z-index (an old pattern) drops it BEHIND the scrim — the whole page
           greys out and the drawer becomes unclickable. */

        /* Ship-status filter pills (multi-select toggles). */
        .status-pills { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }
        .fs-label { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #94a3b8; }
        .fs-sep { width: 1px; align-self: stretch; background: #e2e8f0; margin: 0 6px; }
        .fs-date { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
        .fs-date select, .fs-date input[type=date] { height: 28px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0 8px; font-size: 12px; font-family: inherit; background: #fff; color: #334155; cursor: pointer; }
        .fs-date input[type=date] { cursor: text; }
        .spill-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 28px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; background: #fff; color: #475569; font: inherit; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; }
        .spill-btn:hover { background: #f1f5f9; }
        .spill-btn.on { color: #fff; }
        .spill-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; }

        /* Carrier multi-select dropdown (self-contained, inline-onclick — the
           fb-lib MultiSelect's listeners don't fire in this embedded browser). */
        .cdrop { position: relative; display: inline-block; }
        .cdrop-trigger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 6px; background: #fff; color: #334155; font: inherit; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; max-width: 240px; }
        .cdrop-trigger:hover { background: #f1f5f9; }
        .cdrop-trigger svg { width: 13px; height: 13px; color: #64748b; flex-shrink: 0; }
        .cdrop-trigger .lbl { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
        .cdrop-panel { position: absolute; z-index: 30; top: calc(100% + 3px); left: 0; min-width: 220px; max-width: 320px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.14); display: flex; flex-direction: column; max-height: 320px; }
        .cdrop-panel.hidden { display: none; }
        .cdrop-actions { display: flex; gap: 12px; padding: 6px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f5f9; font-size: 11px; }
        .cdrop-actions span { color: #2563eb; cursor: pointer; }
        .cdrop-actions span:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
        .cdrop-list { overflow-y: auto; }
        .cdrop-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 10px; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; color: #334155; }
        .cdrop-item:hover { background: #eff6ff; }
        .cdrop-item.on { color: #1e40af; font-weight: 600; }
        .cdrop-check { width: 14px; text-align: center; color: #2563eb; flex-shrink: 0; }

        .ds-btn { padding: 7px 13px; font-size: 12px; border-radius: 7px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; background: #fff; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; font-weight: 600; color: #334155; }
        .ds-btn:hover { background: #f1f5f9; }
        .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-primary); color: #fff; border-color: var(--color-primary); }
        .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-dark); }
        .ds-btn-admin { background: #fef3c7; border-color: #f59e0b; color: #7c2d12; margin-right: 6px; }
        .ds-lock-badge { background: #fef3c7; color: #92400e; border: 1px solid #f59e0b; padding: 7px 10px; border-radius: 7px; font-size: 12px; margin-bottom: 14px; }

        /* Multi-select widget (carrier filter). */
        .ms-container { position: relative; }
        .ms-trigger { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: nowrap; gap: 3px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 3px 8px; background: #fff; height: 30px; overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px; }
        .ms-trigger:hover { border-color: #9ca3af; }
        .ms-tag { background: #dbeafe; color: #1d4ed8; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 11px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; white-space: nowrap; }
        .ms-tag-x { cursor: pointer; font-weight: bold; }
        .ms-placeholder { color: #9ca3af; }
        .ms-dropdown { position: absolute; z-index: 500; top: calc(100% + 2px); left: 0; right: 0; min-width: 220px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.13); display: flex; flex-direction: column; max-height: 280px; }
        .ms-dropdown.hidden { display: none; }
        .ms-search { padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #f3f4f6; }
        .ms-search input { width: 100%; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; border-radius: 4px; padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 12px; outline: none; font-family: inherit; }
        .ms-actions { padding: 3px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #f3f4f6; display: flex; gap: 10px; font-size: 11px; }
        .ms-actions span { color: #3b82f6; cursor: pointer; }
        .ms-actions span:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
        .ms-list { overflow-y: auto; flex: 1; }
        .ms-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 5px 10px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px; }
        .ms-item:hover { background: #eff6ff; }
        .ms-empty { padding: 12px; color: #9ca3af; font-size: 12px; text-align: center; }

        /* Header export menu. */
        .menu-wrap { position: relative; display: inline-block; }

        /* Split export button — primary Print action + a caret that opens the
           other formats (Google Maps / GPX / KML / CSV). */
        .split-btn { display: inline-flex; }
        .split-btn > .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 5px 10px; }
        .split-btn > .ds-btn svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; flex-shrink: 0; }
        .split-main { border-top-right-radius: 0; border-bottom-right-radius: 0; padding: 5px 8px; }
        .split-caret { border-top-left-radius: 0; border-bottom-left-radius: 0; border-left: none; padding: 5px 7px; }
        .menu { position: absolute; top: calc(100% + 4px); right: 0; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.13); min-width: 200px; z-index: 600; display: none; overflow: hidden; }
        .menu.open { display: block; }
        .menu button { display: flex; width: 100%; gap: 9px; align-items: center; padding: 9px 12px; background: none; border: none; font: inherit; font-size: 12px; color: #334155; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; }
        .menu button:hover { background: #f1f5f9; }
        .menu button svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; flex-shrink: 0; color: #64748b; }
        .menu .sep { height: 1px; background: #f1f5f9; }

        /* App shell + KPI strip. */
        .app-shell { width: 100%; margin: 0; padding: 0; flex: 1 1 auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 0; }
        .kpi-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; align-items: center; padding: 8px 12px; background: #fff; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; flex-shrink: 0; position: relative; z-index: 1050; }
        .kpi-tile { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 5px 11px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid; line-height: 1.4; }
        .kpi-tile.total { background: #eff6ff; border-color: #bfdbfe; color: #1e40af; }
        .kpi-tile.dist  { background: #ecfeff; border-color: #a5f3fc; color: #155e75; }
        .kpi-tile.time  { background: #f5f3ff; border-color: #ddd6fe; color: #5b21b6; }
        .kpi-tile.warn  { background: #fef3c7; border-color: #fcd34d; color: #92400e; }
        .kpi-tile .lbl  { opacity: 0.85; }
        .kpi-tile .num  { font-weight: 800; }

        /* Two-pane route workspace. */
        .route-wrap { flex: 1 1 auto; display: flex; min-height: 0; }
        .stops-pane { width: 440px; flex-shrink: 0; border-right: 1px solid #e2e8f0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: #fff; overflow: hidden; }
        .stops-head { padding: 9px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
        .stops-head .sum { font-size: 11.5px; color: #475569; font-weight: 600; }
        .stops-list { overflow: auto; flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 0; }
        .map-pane { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; position: relative; background: #eef2f6; }
        #mapEl { position: absolute; inset: 0; }
        .map-msg { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-align: center; color: #64748b; font-size: 13px; padding: 24px; }
        @media (max-width: 860px) {
            .route-wrap { flex-direction: column; }
            .stops-pane { width: auto; height: 45%; border-right: none; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; }
            .map-pane { height: 55%; }
        }

        .stop { display: flex; gap: 10px; padding: 9px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f5f9; cursor: pointer; }
        .stop:hover { background: #f8fafc; }
        .stop.active { background: #eff6ff; }
        .stop-seq { width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 50%; background: #1e3a5f; color: #fff; font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; }
        .stop-seq.depot { background: #059669; }
        .stop-seq.unmapped { background: #b91c1c; }
        .stop-body { min-width: 0; flex: 1; }
        .stop-cust { font-weight: 600; font-size: 12.5px; color: #0f172a; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
        .stop-addr { font-size: 11.5px; color: #64748b; }
        .stop-meta { margin-top: 3px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; }
        .stop-chip { font-size: 12px; background: #f1f5f9; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 4px; padding: 1px 7px; color: #475569; }
        .stop-chip a { color: #2d9cdb; text-decoration: none; }
        .stop-chip a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
        .stops-section { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #94a3b8; padding: 8px 12px 4px; background: #f8fafc; border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f5f9; }
        .stop.excluded-row { opacity: 0.5; }
        .stop-chk { width: 15px; height: 15px; flex-shrink: 0; margin: 3px 0 0; accent-color: var(--color-primary); cursor: pointer; }
        .stop-chk-spacer { width: 15px; flex-shrink: 0; }
        .stop.dragging { opacity: 0.4; }
        .stop.dragover { box-shadow: inset 0 2px 0 var(--color-primary); }
        .stop-grip { margin-left: 8px; align-self: center; flex-shrink: 0; color: #cbd5e1; cursor: grab; display: flex; }
        .stop-grip:hover { color: #94a3b8; }
        .stop-grip:active { cursor: grabbing; }
        .stop-grip svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

        /* Stop header row: customer name (left) + carrier pill (right, opposite). */
        .stop-topline { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; }
        .stop-topline .stop-cust { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; }
        .stop-carrier { flex-shrink: 0; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: #64748b; background: #f1f5f9; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 4px; padding: 1px 7px; max-width: 45%; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

        /* Collapsible per-stop orders table (SO / Ship / …). Collapsed by default
           so an address with many orders stays compact. */
        .stop-orders { margin-top: 5px; }
        .stop-orders-head { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: #475569; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; padding: 1px 0; }
        .stop-orders-head:hover { color: #1e3a5f; }
        .stop-orders-head .chev { width: 12px; height: 12px; color: #94a3b8; transition: transform .15s; flex-shrink: 0; }
        .stop-orders.open .stop-orders-head .chev { transform: rotate(90deg); }
        .stop-orders-body { display: none; margin-top: 4px; }
        .stop-orders.open .stop-orders-body { display: block; }
        .orders-tbl { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 11.5px; }
        .orders-tbl th { text-align: left; font-weight: 700; color: #94a3b8; font-size: 9.5px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; padding: 2px 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; white-space: nowrap; }
        .orders-tbl td { padding: 2px 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f5f9; color: #475569; vertical-align: top; }
        .orders-tbl tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }
        .orders-tbl td.nc, .orders-tbl th.nc { text-align: center; }
        .orders-tbl a { color: #2d9cdb; text-decoration: none; }
        .orders-tbl a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

        /* QR slide-up drawer below the stop list (only shown once routed). */
        .qr-drawer { flex-shrink: 0; border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0; background: #fff; }
        .qr-drawer-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: #334155; }
        .qr-drawer-head:hover { background: #f8fafc; }
        .qr-drawer-head svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; color: #64748b; }
        .qr-drawer-head .chev { margin-left: auto; color: #94a3b8; transition: transform .2s; }
        .qr-drawer.collapsed .qr-drawer-head .chev { transform: rotate(180deg); }
        .qr-drawer-body { max-height: 210px; overflow: hidden; transition: max-height .2s ease; }
        .qr-drawer.collapsed .qr-drawer-body { max-height: 0; }
        .qr-body-inner { padding: 4px 12px 12px; display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center; }
        .qr-imgwrap { width: 118px; height: 118px; flex-shrink: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #94a3b8; font-size: 11px; text-align: center; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 6px; }
        .qr-imgwrap img { width: 116px; height: 116px; display: block; }
        .qr-cap { font-size: 11.5px; color: #475569; line-height: 1.4; }
        .qr-cap strong { color: #0f172a; }
        .qr-cap a { color: #2d9cdb; word-break: break-all; }

        /* Header left cluster: title + LG selector + round-trip toggle. */
        .hdr-left { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
        .hdr-lg { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #475569; }
        .hdr-lg select { height: 34px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0 8px; font-size: 12px; font-family: inherit; background: #fff; color: #334155; max-width: 190px; cursor: pointer; }
        .hdr-ms { min-width: 165px; max-width: 240px; }
        .hdr-ms .ms-trigger { height: 34px; border-color: #cbd5e1; }
        .rt-seg { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 7px; overflow: hidden; }
        .rt-seg button { border: none; background: #fff; color: #475569; font: inherit; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; padding: 7px 12px; cursor: pointer; }
        .rt-seg button + button { border-left: 1px solid #cbd5e1; }
        .rt-seg button.active { background: var(--color-primary); color: #fff; }

        /* Busy overlay (route optimisation in progress). */
        .busy-overlay { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 800; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.62); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
        .busy-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.12); padding: 16px 22px; text-align: center; font-size: 12.5px; color: #334155; font-weight: 600; }
        .spinner { border: 3px solid #e2e8f0; border-top-color: var(--color-primary); border-radius: 50%; width: 34px; height: 34px; animation: spin 1s linear infinite; margin: 0 auto 8px; }
        @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

        /* Numbered map pin. */
        .map-pin { background: #1e3a5f; color: #fff; border-radius: 50% 50% 50% 0; transform: rotate(-45deg); width: 26px; height: 26px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; border: 2px solid #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); }
        .map-pin span { transform: rotate(45deg); }
        .map-pin.depot { background: #059669; }

        /* Toast (hand-rolled against fb-styles .toast classes). */
        .toast-container { position: fixed; bottom: 16px; right: 16px; z-index: 12000; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }

        .empty-msg { padding: 40px 20px; text-align: center; color: #94a3b8; font-size: 13px; }

        @media print {
            header, .fb-drawer, .fblib-debug-drawer, .kpi-row, .stops-head { display: none !important; }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- ==================================================================== HEADER -->
<header>
    <div class="hdr-left">

    return { geometry: f.geometry.coordinates, distance: f.properties.summary.distance, duration: f.properties.summary.duration };

// Fallback: nearest-neighbour order on straight-line distance (offline-safe once coords exist).
function nnOrder(depot, stops) {
    var remaining = stops.slice(), order = [], cur = [depot.lon, depot.lat];
    while (remaining.length) {
        var bi = 0, bd = Infinity;
        for (var i = 0; i < remaining.length; i++) { var d = haversine(cur, remaining[i].coord); if (d < bd) { bd = d; bi = i; } }
        cur = remaining[bi].coord; order.push(remaining.splice(bi, 1)[0]);

}
// Decode a Google/VROOM encoded polyline (precision 5) → [[lon,lat]...].
function decodePolyline(str, precision) {
    var index = 0, lat = 0, lng = 0, out = [], factor = Math.pow(10, precision === undefined ? 5 : precision), byte, shift, result;
    while (index < str.length) {
        shift = 0; result = 0;
        do { byte = str.charCodeAt(index++) - 63; result |= (byte & 0x1f) << shift; shift += 5; } while (byte >= 0x20);
        lat += (result & 1) ? ~(result >> 1) : (result >> 1);
        shift = 0; result = 0;
        do { byte = str.charCodeAt(index++) - 63; result |= (byte & 0x1f) << shift; shift += 5; } while (byte >= 0x20);
        lng += (result & 1) ? ~(result >> 1) : (result >> 1);
        out.push([lng / factor, lat / factor]);
    }
    return out;
}

// ============================================================================
//  DEPOT RESOLUTION
//  ----
//  Company mode uses the SELECTED location group's own Ship-To address from the
//  `address` table (address.accountId = the company's account AND
//  address.locationGroupId = the selected LG). Address type IDs are
//  install-specific (in this DB Ship To=10, Bill To=20, Main Office=50), so we
//  rank by the addresstype NAME — prefer "Ship To", then "Main Office", and push
//  "Bill To"/"Remit" last — but strictly WITHIN that LG. If the LG has no address
//  we fail with a clear message rather than borrowing another LG's address (the
//  old getCompanyAddress() fell back to the LG *name*, e.g. "Perth", which
//  geocoded to the wrong city). The fielded result is geocoded via the structured
//  endpoint (address/city/region/postalcode/country).
// ============================================================================
var _companyAcctPromise = null;
function companyAccountId() {
    // Home-company account id (default company). Falls back to 1 if unresolved.
    if (!_companyAcctPromise) {
        _companyAcctPromise = (async function () {
            try {
                var rows = await runQueryP('SELECT accountid FROM company ORDER BY (defaultflag + 0) DESC, id LIMIT 1');
                var id = rows.length ? parseInt(rows[0].accountid, 10) : NaN;
                return isNaN(id) ? 1 : id;
            } catch (_) { return 1; }
        })();
    }
    return _companyAcctPromise;
}

async function loadDepotAddress(lg) {
    var acctId = await companyAccountId();
    var hasLg = (lg != null && !isNaN(lg));
    var sql = [
        'SELECT a.address, a.city, a.zip, st.code AS state, cc.abbreviation AS country,',
        '       a.typeid AS type_id, t.name AS type_name, a.locationgroupid AS lg_id',
        'FROM address a',
        'LEFT JOIN stateconst st ON st.id = a.stateid',
        'LEFT JOIN countryconst cc ON cc.id = a.countryid',
        'LEFT JOIN addresstype t ON t.id = a.typeid',
        'WHERE a.accountid = ' + acctId,
        // Strictly scope to the selected location group (when one is chosen) so
        // the depot is THAT LG's own address — never another LG's.
        hasLg ? ('  AND a.locationgroupid = ' + lg) : '',
        // Within the LG, rank by addresstype NAME (install-independent): Ship To
        // first, then Main Office, pushing Bill To / Remit last; then default-flag.
        "ORDER BY (LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%ship%') DESC, " +
                 "(LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%main%') DESC, " +
                 "(LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%bill%' OR LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%remit%'), " +
                 '(a.defaultflag + 0) DESC, a.id',
        'LIMIT 1'
    ].filter(Boolean).join('\n');
    var rows = await runQueryP(sql);
    if (!rows.length) return null;
    var r = rows[0];
    return {
        address: r.address || '', city: r.city || '', state: r.state || '', zip: r.zip || '', country: r.country || '',
        typeName: r.type_name || ('type ' + r.type_id),
        lgMatch: hasLg && r.lg_id != null && String(r.lg_id) === String(lg)
    };
}

async function resolveDepot() {

        }
        var addr = String(_resolve('depotAddress', '')).trim();
        if (addr) {
            var c = await geocodeCached('depot|' + addr, function () { return orsGeocodeText(addr); });
            if (c) return { lon: c[0], lat: c[1], label: addr, lgName: 'Trip start (manual)' };

        throw new Error('Manual depot is selected but no valid coordinates/address are set in Settings.');

function buildSQL() {
    var r = getDateRange();
    var dateOk = r.start && r.end && safeDate(r.start) && safeDate(r.end);
    var conds = [];

    // One OR-group per selected ship status. Shipped (30) filters on the ship
    // date; Packed (20) / Entered (10) have no true timestamp so match on
    // last-modified (approximate). No status selected → return nothing.
    var sids = Array.from(_statusSel).filter(function (id) { return /^\d+$/.test(id); });
    if (sids.length) {
        var statusConds = sids.map(function (id) {
            var dateCol = (id === '30') ? 'ship.dateshipped' : 'ship.datelastmodified';
            return '(ship.statusid = ' + Number(id) + (dateOk ? " AND DATE(" + dateCol + ") BETWEEN '" + r.start + "' AND '" + r.end + "'" : '') + ')';
        });
        conds.push('(' + statusConds.join(' OR ') + ')');
    } else {
        conds.push('1 = 0');   // nothing selected → no rows
    }

    var cs = Array.from(_carrierSel).map(Number).filter(function (n) { return !isNaN(n); });
    if (cs.length) conds.push('ship.carrierid IN (' + cs.join(',') + ')');
    if (_lgId != null && !isNaN(_lgId)) {
        conds.push('ship.locationgroupid = ' + _lgId);
    } else {
        var lgs = accessibleLgIds().map(Number).filter(function (n) { return !isNaN(n); });
        if (lgs.length) conds.push('ship.locationgroupid IN (' + lgs.join(',') + ')');
    }

    return [
        // Prefer the SHIP record's own ship-to (the actual destination for this
        // shipment) and fall back to the SO's ship-to only when a ship field is
        // blank. NULLIF turns empty strings into NULL so COALESCE can skip them.
        'SELECT ship.id AS ship_id, ship.num AS ship_num, ship.statusid AS status_id,',
        '       ship.dateshipped AS date_shipped, ship.cartoncount AS cartons,',
        '       ship.locationgroupid AS lg_id,',
        '       so.num AS so_num, so.id AS so_id, c.name AS customer,',
        // Shipment contact (ship.contact) + the SO\'s contact email/phone
        // (ship has no email/phone columns) + the free-text ship note — all
        // for the printed run-sheet.
        '       ship.contact AS contact, ship.note AS ship_note,',
        '       so.email AS contact_email, so.phone AS contact_phone,',
        '       COALESCE(NULLIF(ship.shiptoname, \'\'), so.shiptoname) AS ship_to_name,',
        '       COALESCE(NULLIF(ship.shiptoaddress, \'\'), so.shiptoaddress) AS ship_to_address,',
        '       COALESCE(NULLIF(ship.shiptocity, \'\'), so.shiptocity) AS ship_to_city,',
        '       COALESCE(NULLIF(ship.shiptozip, \'\'), so.shiptozip) AS ship_to_zip,',
        '       st.code AS ship_to_state, cc.abbreviation AS ship_to_country',
        '       , carrier.name AS carrier',
        'FROM ship',
        'JOIN so ON so.id = ship.soid AND ship.ordertypeid = 20',
        'JOIN customer c ON c.id = so.customerid',
        'JOIN carrier ON carrier.id = ship.carrierid',
        'LEFT JOIN stateconst st ON st.id = COALESCE(ship.shiptostateid, so.shiptostateid)',
        'LEFT JOIN countryconst cc ON cc.id = COALESCE(ship.shiptocountryid, so.shiptocountryid)',
        'WHERE ' + conds.join(' AND '),
        'ORDER BY ship.num',
        'LIMIT 2000'
    ].join('\n');
}

// Group shipment rows into unique delivery stops (one per ship-to address).
// When several shipments share an address but belong to DIFFERENT customer
// accounts, the stop is labelled "Multiple Customers" — the distinct names are
// kept in s.customers for a hover tooltip, the map popup and the CSV manifest.
function groupStops(rows) {
    var byKey = {};
    var stops = [];
    rows.forEach(function (r) {
        var addr1 = String(r.ship_to_address || '').split(/[\r\n]+/)[0].trim();
        var key = [addr1, r.ship_to_city, r.ship_to_state, r.ship_to_zip, r.ship_to_country]
            .map(function (x) { return String(x || '').toLowerCase().trim(); }).join('|');
        var s = byKey[key];
        if (!s) {
            s = {
                key: key,
                name: r.ship_to_name || r.customer || '',
                customer: r.customer || '',
                custSet: {},          // distinct customer-account names seen at this address
                address: addr1,
                city: r.ship_to_city || '',
                state: r.ship_to_state || '',
                zip: r.ship_to_zip || '',
                country: r.ship_to_country || '',
                shipments: [],
                coord: _geoCache[key] || null,
                seq: null
            };
            byKey[key] = s; stops.push(s);
        }
        if (r.customer) s.custSet[r.customer] = true;
        s.shipments.push({ ship_num: r.ship_num, so_num: r.so_num, carrier: r.carrier, cartons: r.cartons, customer: r.customer, shiptoname: r.ship_to_name, contact: r.contact, email: r.contact_email, phone: r.contact_phone, note: r.ship_note });
    });
    // Finalise each stop's label: >1 distinct customer at a single address →
    // "Multiple Customers" (the real names are preserved in s.customers for the
    // tooltip / popup / export).
    stops.forEach(function (s) {
        s.customers = Object.keys(s.custSet);
        delete s.custSet;
        if (s.customers.length > 1) {
            s.multiCustomer = true;
            s.name = 'Multiple Customers';
            s.customer = 'Multiple Customers';
        }
    });
    return stops;
}

async function planRoute() {

    var btn = document.getElementById('optimizeBtn'); if (btn) btn.disabled = true;
    setStatus('Planning route…'); setBusy(true, 'Planning route…');
    try {
        _depot = await resolveDepot();

        // Geocode every stop concurrently (cache-first) so the include/exclude
        // checkboxes and any later re-optimize work without re-hitting the geocoder.
        var geoErrs = await geocodeStopsConcurrent(_stops, 5);
        _geoStatus = summariseGeo(_stops, geoErrs);   // update the Unmapped-header reason
        if (!_stops.some(function (x) { return x.coord && !x.excluded; })) {
            _orderedStops = []; _route = null; renderAll();
            showToast('No routable stops — ' + (_geoStatus ? _geoStatus.text : 'all stops are deselected') + '.', 'error', 7000);
            return;

// Optimize + draw the INCLUDED (checked) geocoded stops. Assumes the depot is
// resolved and stops are geocoded (planRoute does that once). Re-run cheaply
// whenever the selection changes — no depot re-resolve, no re-geocode.
async function computeRoute() {
    if (!_depot) return;
    _planned = true;        // switch the stop list from preview to the planned view
    _manualOrder = false;   // optimizing discards any manual (reverse/drag) order

// so the browser sends NO Referer header — and tile.openstreetmap.org answers
// every referer-less request with its "app is not following the tile usage

// a perfectly successful load and the refusal text is simply baked into the
// tile. Unfixable from here (Referer is a forbidden request header and a data:
// document has none to send), so OSM's own tile servers are unusable for
// Fishbowl reports. CARTO and Esri don't gate on referrer and both answer with
// `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`; verified referer-less 2026-09-18. The map
// data is still OpenStreetMap's — only the rendering/hosting differs.
// Policy: https://operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/tiles/
var TILE_PROVIDERS = [
    {
        url: 'https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/rastertiles/voyager/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png',
        opts: { subdomains: 'abcd', maxZoom: 20, attribution: '© OpenStreetMap contributors © CARTO' }
    },
    {
        url: 'https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Street_Map/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}',
        opts: { maxZoom: 19, attribution: 'Tiles © Esri' }

// to load (host blocked by a proxy / firewall). Leaflet fires tileerror once
// per tile, so wait for a handful before condemning the provider.
function useTileProvider(map, idx) {
    var p = TILE_PROVIDERS[idx];
    if (!p) {
        showMapMsg('Map tiles unavailable — this machine cannot reach the tile servers. Routing, the stop list and the exports still work.');
        return;
    }
    if (_tileLayer) { map.removeLayer(_tileLayer); _tileLayer = null; }
    var errs = 0;
    var layer = L.tileLayer(p.url, p.opts);
    layer.on('tileerror', function () { if (++errs === 5) useTileProvider(map, idx + 1); });

function downloadBlob(name, mime, text) {
    var blob = new Blob([text], { type: mime });
    var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    var a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url; a.download = name; a.rel = 'noopener'; a.style.display = 'none';
    document.body.appendChild(a); a.click();
    // Defer cleanup: revoking the object URL / removing the anchor synchronously
    // can truncate or cancel the download in Chromium/JxBrowser before it has
    // finished reading the blob. Give it a few seconds.
    setTimeout(function () { try { document.body.removeChild(a); } catch (_) {} try { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); } catch (_) {} }, 4000);
}

// Build the Google Maps directions deep-link for the current optimized route
// (round-trip: origin = destination = depot). Returns { url, dropped } or null.
function gmapsUrl() {
    if (!_orderedStops.length || !_depot) return null;
    var pts = _orderedStops.filter(function (s) { return s.coord; });
    if (!pts.length) return null;
    var ll = function (s) { return s.coord[1] + ',' + s.coord[0]; };
    var origin = _depot.lat + ',' + _depot.lon;
    var dest, wp, dropped;
    if (isRoundTrip()) {
        dest = origin;                                   // return to depot
        wp = pts.slice(0, GMAPS_MAX).map(ll);
        dropped = Math.max(0, pts.length - GMAPS_MAX);
    } else {
        dest = ll(pts[pts.length - 1]);                  // end at the last delivery
        var mid = pts.slice(0, pts.length - 1);
        wp = mid.slice(0, GMAPS_MAX).map(ll);
        dropped = Math.max(0, mid.length - GMAPS_MAX);
    }
    var url = 'https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&travelmode=driving&origin=' + origin + '&destination=' + dest +
              (wp.length ? '&waypoints=' + encodeURIComponent(wp.join('|')) : '');
    return { url: url, dropped: dropped };
}

function openGmaps() {
    closeExportMenu();

    if (g.dropped) showToast('Google Maps allows ' + GMAPS_MAX + ' stops per link — first ' + GMAPS_MAX + ' of ' + (_orderedStops.filter(function (s) { return s.coord; }).length) + ' included.', 'warn', 6000);
    try { window.open(g.url, '_blank'); } catch (_) { showToast('Could not open Google Maps (popup blocked).', 'error'); }
}

// ── QR code (route deep-link) ────────────────────────────────
// Rendered from the QRServer API and cached as a data-URI so the same image can
// be shown on screen AND embedded self-contained in the printed run-sheet.
var _qrCache = {};
async function qrDataUrl(text) {
    if (_qrCache[text]) return _qrCache[text];
    try {
        var api = 'https://api.qrserver.com/v1/create-qr-code/?size=240x240&margin=1&format=png&data=' + encodeURIComponent(text);
        var res = await fetch(api);
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error('QR HTTP ' + res.status);
        var blob = await res.blob();
        var dataUrl = await new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
            var fr = new FileReader(); fr.onload = function () { resolve(fr.result); }; fr.onerror = reject; fr.readAsDataURL(blob);
        });
        _qrCache[text] = dataUrl;
        return dataUrl;
    } catch (e) { debugLog('QR generate failed: ' + e.message, 'warn'); return null; }
}

}

// Explode the ordered stops into per-customer manifest lines: a shared address
// serving several customer accounts becomes one line PER customer (all keeping
// the stop's sequence number), so each customer is signed for separately on the
// run-sheet / CSV. A single-customer stop passes through as one line.
function manifestLines(ordered) {
    var out = [];
    // Distinct, non-empty, trimmed values of a field across a customer's shipments.
    var uniqField = function (shs, key) {
        var seen = {}, arr = [];
        shs.forEach(function (x) { var v = (x[key] == null ? '' : String(x[key])).trim(); if (v && !seen[v]) { seen[v] = 1; arr.push(v); } });
        return arr;
    };
    ordered.forEach(function (s, i) {
        var seq = s.seq || (i + 1);
        var addrFull = [s.address, s.city, s.state, s.zip].filter(Boolean).join(', ');
        // Bucket this stop's shipments by customer account, preserving first-seen order.
        var byCust = {}, order = [];
        (s.shipments || []).forEach(function (sh) {
            var cust = sh.customer || s.customer || '';
            if (!byCust[cust]) { byCust[cust] = []; order.push(cust); }
            byCust[cust].push(sh);
        });
        if (!order.length) { order.push(s.customer || ''); byCust[s.customer || ''] = []; }   // stop with no shipments (safety)
        order.forEach(function (cust, ci) {
            var shs = byCust[cust] || [];
            out.push({
                seq: seq,
                seqShown: ci === 0,     // show the number only on the first line of the stop
                customer: cust,
                shipToName: (shs[0] && shs[0].shiptoname) || cust,
                address1: s.address || '', address: addrFull,
                city: s.city || '', state: s.state || '', zip: s.zip || '', country: s.country || '',
                soNums:   shs.map(function (x) { return x.so_num; }).filter(Boolean).join(', '),
                shipNums: shs.map(function (x) { return x.ship_num; }).filter(Boolean).join(', '),
                carrier:  (shs[0] && shs[0].carrier) || '',
                cartons:  shs.reduce(function (a, x) { return a + (parseFloat(x.cartons) || 0); }, 0),
                contacts: uniqField(shs, 'contact'),
                emails:   uniqField(shs, 'email'),
                phones:   uniqField(shs, 'phone'),
                notes:    uniqField(shs, 'note')
            });
        });
    });
    return out;
}

    var lines = [cols.map(function (c) { return '"' + c + '"'; }).join(',')];

async function printRunSheet() {
    closeExportMenu();
    var ordered = _orderedStops.length ? _orderedStops : _stops;
    if (!ordered.length) { showToast('No stops to print.', 'info'); return; }

    // One row per customer — a shared address with several customers lists each
    // separately (the seq number is printed once, on the stop's first line). The
    // Contact cell stacks the shipment contact name + email + phone; a ship note,
    // when present, prints as a full-width sub-row beneath the line.
    var rows = manifestLines(ordered).map(function (ln, i) {

            ln.contacts.length ? '<div>' + e(ln.contacts.join(', ')) + '</div>' : '',

            '<td class="nc">' + (ln.seqShown ? ln.seq : '') + '</td>' +

            '<td>' + contactCell + '</td>' +
            '<td>' + e(ln.address) + '</td>' +
            '<td>' + e(ln.soNums) + '</td>' +

            '<td class="nc">' + (ln.cartons ? e(ln.cartons) : '') + '</td>' +
            '<td class="nc">◻</td></tr>';
        var noteRow = hasNote
            ? '<tr class="noterow' + band + '"><td></td><td colspan="7"><span class="notelbl">Note:</span> ' + e(ln.notes.join(' · ')) + '</td></tr>'
            : '';
        return main + noteRow;
    }).join('');
    var totals = 'Start: ' + e(_depot ? ((_depot.lgName ? _depot.lgName + ' — ' : '') + (_depot.label || 'Warehouse')) : 'Warehouse') +
        (_route ? ' · ' + fmtKm(_route.distance) + ' · ' + fmtDur(_route.duration) : '');
    // Embed the route QR (data-URI, so the print window is self-contained).
    var g = gmapsUrl();
    var qrData = g ? await qrDataUrl(g.url) : null;
    var qrBlock = qrData
        ? '<div class="qr"><img src="' + qrData + '" alt="Route QR" width="120" height="120"/><div class="qrcap">Scan for turn-by-turn<br>in Google Maps</div></div>'
        : '';
    var html = '<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="UTF-8"/><title>Delivery Run-Sheet</title><style>' +
        'body{font-family:Arial,sans-serif;font-size:9pt;margin:.4in;color:#111}' +
        '.hd{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:16px}' +
        'h2{font-size:13pt;margin:0 0 2px;color:#1e3a5f}.sub{font-size:8pt;color:#555;margin:0 0 10px}' +
        '.qr{text-align:center;flex-shrink:0}.qr img{border:1px solid #e5e7eb}.qrcap{font-size:7pt;color:#555;margin-top:2px;line-height:1.3}' +
        'table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%}th{background:#1e3a5f;color:#fff;font-size:8pt;padding:5px 6px;text-align:left;-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact;print-color-adjust:exact}' +
        'td{font-size:8.5pt;padding:5px 6px;border-bottom:1px solid #e5e7eb;vertical-align:top}' +
        '.band td{background:#f7f9fb;-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact;print-color-adjust:exact}' +
        '.row.hasnote td{border-bottom:none}.noterow td{font-size:8pt;color:#444;padding-top:0}.notelbl{font-weight:bold;color:#1e3a5f}' +
        '.csub{font-size:7.5pt;color:#555;line-height:1.35}.muted{color:#999}' +
        '.nc{text-align:center}@page{size:A4 portrait;margin:.4in}</style></head><body>' +
        '<div class="hd"><div><h2>Delivery Run-Sheet — ' + moment().format('ddd D MMM YYYY') + '</h2>' +
        '<p class="sub">' + e(totals) + '</p></div>' + qrBlock + '</div>' +
        '<table><thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Customer</th><th>Contact</th><th>Address</th><th>SO</th><th>Carrier</th><th class="nc">Ctns</th><th>Done</th></tr></thead><tbody>' + rows + '</tbody></table>' +
        '</body></html>';
    var w = window.open('', '_blank');
    if (!w) { showToast('Print popup blocked.', 'error'); return; }

// Repaint the truck fields in the active unit system: swap the unit in each label
// and convert the STORED (metric) value into display units. Called on hydrate and
// whenever the units selector changes — it reads from settings, never from the
// inputs, so switching units can't compound a conversion.
function _renderHgvUnits() {
    var sysName = unitSystem();
    HGV_FIELDS.forEach(function (f) {
        var def = unitDef(f.kind);
        var lbl = document.querySelector('.uom[data-uom="' + f.key + '"]');
        if (lbl) lbl.textContent = def.label;
        var el = document.getElementById(f.el); if (!el) return;
        var ors = parseFloat(_resolve(f.key, ''));
        el.value = isFinite(ors) ? String(_round(ors * def.perOrs, def.dp)) : '';
        // Spinner arrows are useful on a 4.2 m height, meaningless on an 80,000 lb
        // weight — and a fixed step there would mark an odd figure like 26,450 as
        // :invalid, so drop the step constraint for whole-number units.
        el.step = def.dp ? '0.1' : 'any';
    });
    var help = document.getElementById('hgvUnitsHelp');
    if (help) {
        help.textContent = (_resolve('hgvUnits', 'auto') === 'auto')
            ? 'Detected from this database: ' + (_dbUnits || 'metric') + '. Whatever you type is converted to tonnes / metres for the map service.'
            : 'Overriding the database default (' + (_dbUnits || 'metric') + ').';
    }
    return sysName;
}
// Round to n decimals without the 0.30000000000000004 tail.
function _round(v, dp) { var f = Math.pow(10, dp); return Math.round(v * f) / f; }

function publishDefaults() {
    if (!FBLib.Settings.isAdmin()) return;
    if (!confirm('Publish current route settings as the default for all users?')) return;
    try {
        var master = Object.assign({}, FBLib.Settings.getMaster());
        master.profile = document.getElementById('setProfile').value;
        // Publish the fleet's truck spec too — one vehicle profile per org is the
        // normal case, so admins shouldn't have to dictate it to every driver.
        HGV_FIELDS.forEach(function (f) {
            var el = document.getElementById(f.el); if (!el) return;

            master[f.key] = (isFinite(v) && v > 0) ? _round(v / unitDef(f.kind).perOrs, 4) : '';

        var hzEl = document.getElementById('setHgvHazmat');

        // Publish the units preference too, so drivers see the fleet's own units.
        master.hgvUnits = document.getElementById('setHgvUnits').value;
        FBLib.Settings.publishMaster(master);
        debugLog('Defaults published', 'success');
        showToast('Defaults published.', 'success');

function _refreshAdminUi() {
    var isAdmin = FBLib.Settings.isAdmin();
    document.getElementById('dsAdminSection').style.display = isAdmin ? 'block' : 'none';
    var allowed = FBLib.Settings.userEditingAllowed();
    document.getElementById('dsLockBadge').style.display = (!allowed && !isAdmin) ? 'block' : 'none';
    var lockBtn = document.getElementById('dsLockBtn');
    if (lockBtn) lockBtn.textContent = allowed ? 'Lock user editing' : 'Unlock user editing';
}

// ============================================================================
//  DEBUG DRAWER
// ============================================================================
var _debugApi = null;
function _applyDebugDrawer(showIt) {
    if (!_debugApi) _debugApi = FBLib.Common.mountDebugDrawer();
    if (!_debugApi) return;
    if (showIt) { _debugApi.show(); _debugApi.expand(); } else _debugApi.hide();
    if (_debugApi.element) _observeDebugDrawer(_debugApi.element);
}
function _observeDebugDrawer(el) {
    if (!el || el._observed) return;
    el._observed = true;
    var apply = function () {
        var visible = el.classList.contains('is-visible'), open = el.classList.contains('is-open');
        var h = (visible && open) ? Math.ceil(el.getBoundingClientRect().height) : (visible ? 40 : 0);
        document.body.style.setProperty('--debug-drawer-h', h + 'px');
        if (_map) setTimeout(function () { try { _map.invalidateSize(); } catch (_) {} }, 60);
    };
    apply();
    if (typeof ResizeObserver === 'function') { try { new ResizeObserver(apply).observe(el); } catch (_) {} }
    try { new MutationObserver(apply).observe(el, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] }); } catch (_) {}
}

window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async function () {
  try {
    FBLib.Common.registerDrawer({ id: 'setOverlay',     triggerId: 'setBtn'     });
    FBLib.Common.registerDrawer({ id: 'helpOverlay',    triggerId: 'helpBtn'    });

    _geoCache = loadGeoCache();
    // Resolve the database's measurement system before the first hydrate so the
    // truck-restriction labels are never briefly wrong. One indexed single-row
    // query; on failure it settles on metric and hydration proceeds regardless.
    await detectUnitSystem();
    _hydrateSettings();
    _applyDebugDrawer(!!_resolve('showDebug', false));
    _refreshAdminUi();

    // The backdrop scrim behind an open Settings/Help drawer is provided by
    // fb-lib (registerDrawer greys the page + closes on scrim-click/ESC). No
    // local scrim wiring — and never override .fb-drawer.open's z-index (see
    // the CSS note above).

    // Close the export menu + carrier dropdown on any outside click.
    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (!e.target.closest('.menu-wrap')) closeExportMenu();
        if (!e.target.closest('#carrierDrop')) carrierDropClose();
    });
    window.addEventListener('resize', function () { if (_map) setTimeout(function () { try { _map.invalidateSize(); } catch (_) {} }, 60); });

    await loadFilters();
    await loadAll();
    debugLog('Delivery Route Planner initialised', 'success');
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[Route Planner init] failed:', e);
    setStatus('Init failed — ' + (e && e.message ? e.message : 'see browser console'));
    try { FBLib.Common.debugLog('Init failed: ' + (e && e.stack ? e.stack : e), 'error'); } catch (_) {}
  }
});
